24.original: Collect a piece of poxyleaf waterweed.

25.original: Collect a piece of fancyleaf waterweed.

26.original: Collect a piece of gaudyleaf waterweed.

27.original: Return the waterweed samples to Tempatriq.

48.original: Oh, what is Tempatriq to do? It is so near, and yet so far...

49.original: Earlend Tempatriq, lowlander! She told potsworn friend about the beautiful waterweed of Marsh Ligaka, and potsworn friend says she wants to study it closeeyes.

50.original: But waterweed grows at the bottom of the water, and Tempatriq can't fishwalk. Can't ask potsworn to collect it herself, either─it would go against the potpact. You wouldn't happen to be a talented fishwalker, would you?

51.original: ...You're a talented fish<hex:021A020203>breather<hex:021A020103>, too!? Then you are the perfect lowlander for the job!

52.original: Need to gather three types of waterweed from Marsh Ligaka: poxyleaf is pink and poisonlooking, fancyleaf is lacy and lovely, and gaudyleaf is super shimmershiny! Please find them for Tempatriq!

53.original: Many kinds of waterweed grow in Marsh Ligaka. Tempatriq only needs you to collect three of the most distinctive: poxyleaf type, fancyleaf type, and gaudyleaf type.

54.original: Pfff... Pfffkohhh... Did you find the waterweed?

55.original: Wonderdeeds! They're even more beautiful up close than they are in the water!

56.original: Tempatriq will show them to her potsworn friend right away! They're sure to give her plenty of mindfruit.

57.original: She is an expert at reproducing nature─not only in prettylooks, but in funnytraits, too. This waterweed has a very special funnytrait: it changes color depending on the warmth of the water in which it grows, its exposure to light, or even over the longyears.

58.original: If she can craft danglejewels that do the same, they will surely sell for a potload of jinglyshine!
